CustomField.description: Mobile number masking (v1.5.0): primary number with only the first 2 and last 2 characters visible (98XXXXXX21). For screens, list views and reports of users who cannot see Phone__c.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Phone__c), "", IF( LEN(Phone__c) <= 4, LPAD("", LEN(Phone__c), "X"), LEFT(Phone__c, 2) & LPAD("", LEN(Phone__c) - 4, "X") & RIGHT(Phone__c, 2) ) )
CustomField.label: Phone (Masked)
